critical_code_review_comments: server.py KB_CACHE is updated via load_kb() but is a module-level dict mutated on PUT — safe for single process, but under Uvicorn workers>1 other workers won't see the change until restart. Current supervisor runs a single worker so OK; document this.
/api/selfie/upload stores PNG regardless of actual input mime (always .png + image/png). If client uploads JPEG the stored content-type/filename will mismatch. Minor — detect mime from bytes.
/api/knowledge PUT allows admins to set an empty 'courses.courses' list which would break SECU responses; consider minimum-length validation or a confirm prompt in UI.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan context manager (carried over).
KnowledgeEditor loses unsaved edits on tab switch because state lives in the child; consider a 'dirty' guard.
